newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon invites tenders for 35,000 T wheat.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon invites tenders for 35,000 T wheat.

text.p: Lebanon's economy ministry on Friday invited international firms or their local agents to tender to buy on its behalf 35,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat for end of March shipment.

"We want to buy 35,000 tonnes of U.S. Hard Red Winter No. 2 wheat. The bids will be opened on February 25," an official of the Office of Cereals and Sugar Beet, which is part of the ministry, told Reuters.
"The wheat is for March 15-31 shipment CIF to Beirut port silos," the official added.
On January 8, the ministry said it was planning to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat later in the month but it never invited tenders.
Lebanon has yearly wheat requirements of some 400,000 tonnes.
"Everyone can bid, international grain companies or local ones," the official said.
The economy ministry periodically invites international firms or their Beirut-based agents to tender to purchase wheat on the international market on the Lebanese government's behalf.
In 1996, the ministry bought half of Lebanon's yearly wheat requirements through local agents. Local firms also make purchases for the private sector.
